alt: The ADALET panel: an EQ curve with six bands over a live spectrum
line: Six bands with zero latency, any bell or shelf dynamic. TARGET cuts a named part of a sound, COLLIDE clears the room between two tracks such as kick and bass, SELF finds the resonances of the track it sits on. Hold DELTA to hear only what it cuts. $15, VST3 and AU on macOS, VST3 on Windows.
title: A dynamic EQ that finds the problem for you.
